limitations.note: The counter fix was correct, but decoding its range forces the output low on entry to square mode instead of holding the previous value until a counter threshold is reached.
The triangle rewrite changes reset and mode-entry behavior: from a reset value of 0, the original logic decrements to 31 on the first triangle clock, while the rewrite increments to 1.
The bench treated the rewritten triangle startup as expected and entered square mode only from an already-zero output, so its passing result missed both behavior changes.
